title: dx-sdk-docs-todo-scratchpad
body:
Quick scratchpad for SDK docs + sample apps — chaotic and iterative.

Context:
- Working on getting the JS + Python SDK quickstarts in sync. Recent API changes (streaming API shape + function-calls) broke some of the examples in the tutorial.
- Goal: 1) fix obvious doc gaps, 2) add a minimal sample-app for chat + function-calls, 3) create a small test harness so PRs catch tutorial regressions.

Top priorities (short term):
- [ ] Update JS quickstart to match runtime SDK v1.4.2: streaming example uses "onToken" callback in code samples, docs still show old event API. (blocked: need final API surface from eng)
  - note: see GH PR #582 (linked).
- [ ] Fix Python chat tutorial where "role" parameter was renamed to "actor" in client.chat.create — update examples and sample app instructions.
- [ ] Add a small sample-app repo (mono repo /examples/sdk-chat) with:
    - server: simple express/fastapi + websockets to stream tokens
    - client: minimal React UI that demonstrates function-calls and structured output
- [ ] Write a short troubleshooting section for common streaming errors (token loss, partial responses, reconnect logic).

Medium priority / Nice-to-haves:
- [ ] Add a short section on batching best-practices for the SDK (examples for batch embeddings + continuous batching flags).
- [ ] Document how to pin model variants in requests (dedicated vs hosted) with example config file.
- [ ] Add one-liner code snippets to all quickstarts for copy-paste (JS + Py + curl).

Open questions / blockers:
- API confirmation: eng@serving-runtime changed stream callback signature — need final API doc. Pinged Devon.
- Should we include a Dockerfile for the sample-app? Pros: easier to run locally & in Codelabs. Cons: extra maintenance.
- Which license to pick for example app? CC-BY or Apache-2.0? Ask legal.

Notes for the sample-app (rough):
- README.md flow: 
  1) install deps (yarn/pip)
  2) set REDWOOD_API_KEY env var (explain scopes)
  3) run server, open client
  4) demo: send a chat message -> triggers function-call for "search_docs" -> display structured result
- Keep code minimal: wrapper client to handle streaming + reconnection with exponential backoff.
- Use mocked function-call handler in examples so users can run without external infra. Provide optional real-search integration example.

Tutorial fixes checklist (detailed):
- JS quickstart (pages/getting-started/js.md)
  - replace old streaming snippet with new onToken example
  - add note about content-type and chunk boundaries for server-sent events
  - add copyable curl example for non-streaming case
- Python quickstart (pages/getting-started/python.md)
  - change code samples to client.chat.create(actor=...)
  - add small section about asyncio usage and proper cancellation handling
- Function-calls doc (reference/function-calls.md)
  - add an example of validating function outputs (schema + null handling)
  - include a short table of supported types and max size

Testing / CI ideas:
- Add an integration step in CI that pulls the docs sample-app and runs the quickstart smoke test:
  - start server (docker-compose or local), run a headless client script that asserts expected sequence of events
  - failing CI should block doc PRs that touch quickstarts
- Add linting for docs code blocks using simple regex/runner to ensure example compiles.

Misc notes / quick links to follow up:
- Linear: LINEAR-1234 track sample-app work & CI check.
- GH PR: review and merge PR #582 after updating docs.
- Slack: #dx-docs thread titled "streaming API example change" has ENG confirmations (timestamp 2026-02-20).
- Confluence draft: "SDK Getting Started Draft" has the high-level design we want to port to the site.

Small TODO for today:
- [ ] Draft updated JS streaming snippet (10-20min) and paste into PR comment on #582.
- [ ] Create skeleton repo "examples/sdk-chat" in GH (create issue if no perms).
- [ ] Ping legal about license preference for examples.

Notes to self:
- Keep examples tiny: users rarely run big infra. Focus on clarity over features.
- When in doubt, prefer copy-paste friendly code (no custom build steps).
- Consider adding a short video gif for the tutorial page showing streaming in action (produces better conversion).

Previous edits / history:
- 2026-02-25: created initial scratchpad after sprint planning.
- 2026-02-27: updated with API change notes from dev sync.
- 2026-03-02: added CI testing idea and sample-app skeleton notes.

End of scratchpad.
